statements.query: MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})-[r:RESOURCE]->(:GCPDomain) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Remove GCP Customer to IAM Domains relationships that are out of date. A GCPDomain node (keyed by the domain name) is shared by every tenant that grants that domain a role, and its lastupdated is the last tenant's tag: only this project's edge is removed here.

statements.query: MATCH (n:GCPDomain) WHERE NOT (n)--() AND n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Orphan sweep, tenant-independent: delete a domain only once no tenant links it any more (role grants are removed by gcp_iam_policy_binding_cleanup.json).
